action: Read the full Ask page as one column
user_goal: I want the conversation wider but still easy to read
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px
A working model (the server's or the Codex bridge)
steps: Open Ask in the sidebar
Ask "Can I afford ¥4,000 tonight?"
Read the thread
expected: One centred column of about 760px: the header (Ask, a space chooser, Space), the thread in the middle and the composer at the bottom
The question appears as a bubble on the right and the answer under it with its canvas drawn inside the thread; the column does not shift sideways
Nothing scrolls sideways; light and dark both read clearly

user_goal: I want the space's brief, notes and pins without leaving the conversation
steps: Press Space in the header
Read the sheet
Press Escape, then open it again and press Close Space
Switch pages with the sheet open
expected: A side sheet opens with the space brief, space notes, pinned canvases, earlier conversations, Delete this conversation and the starter canvases
Escape and Close Space close it and return focus to Space
The sheet is closed on the next page; it never leaves the page inert

action: Choose a different space on the full page
user_goal: I want a thread per task
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben) with a second space
steps: Choose the second space in the space chooser
expected: The page shows that space's thread, brief and pins at /canvas?space=<id>; Back returns to General

action: Press the Ask button on the full Ask page and go back
user_goal: I want the button to take me back where I was
steps: On Spending press Ask in the top bar to open the panel
Press Open full in the panel
On /canvas read the Ask button, then press it
Repeat from Bills with the panel closed
expected: On /canvas the top bar's Ask button shows pressed
Pressing it returns to the page the person came from (Spending) with the panel open, and the question and thread typed on the page are in the panel
From Bills with the panel closed it returns to Bills; with no earlier page it returns to Home

action: Use the Ask button on every screen of a household
steps: Open Home, Bills, Cards, Clients, Spending, Saving, Household, Settings and To check, and press Ask on each
Open the sidebar's Ask link
expected: The Ask button is at the top right of every screen and opens and closes the panel; it is open by default at 1200px and wider
The sidebar's Ask opens the full page, not the panel

user_goal: I want to ask while I set up
steps: Type Mika and press Start planning
On /setup?step=bank read the top bar and press Ask
Move to the next step
expected: The Ask button is at the top right of the setup step
It opens the panel over the step (closed by default during setup) and the unsaved form in the step is not submitted by the panel's own Ask
The panel keeps its conversation across steps

user_goal: a narrow desktop window still has the panel
steps: Open Home
Press Ask in the top bar
Press Open full, then the Ask button
expected: The panel is closed by default and opens over the page (not docked) with the Ask button pressed
Open full shows the page and the button returns to Home with the panel open
Below 900px the Ask bar opens the full page instead
